plugins.releaseNameTemplate: <% if (branch.type === 'prerelease' && branch.prerelease === 'hotfix') { %>Hotfix <%= nextRelease.version %> (based on <%= branch.name.replace('hotfix/', '') %>)<% } else { %><%= nextRelease.version %><% } %>
plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<% if (branch.type === 'prerelease' && branch.prerelease === 'hotfix') { %>> **Hotfix** for production version <%= branch.name.replace('hotfix/', '') %>, built from tag <%= branch.name.replace('hotfix/', '') %> without later changes. Not marked as latest.

<% } %><%= nextRelease.notes %>
